name: Picture in picture
plain: Lets video keep playing in a small window while the user uses other apps.
meaning: A small floating window. Android lets users disable it per app; iOS supports PiP via AVKit.

android.prompt_ui: System enters PiP on action; user toggle per app
android.revocation: Settings > Special app access > Picture in picture
android.note: Android 12 added auto-enter and seamless resize.

limits.headline: Can keep a video playing in a small window while you use other apps
limits.user_action: You tap Picture in Picture or swipe home while a video plays
can: Keep a video or call in a small window above other apps
Start the window on its own when you leave the app, on Android 12 and newer
Let you move, resize and close the window
Work on iPhone since iOS 14 for apps with background audio
cannot: Show the window if you turned Picture in Picture off for the app on Android
Run on iPhone without the background audio setting the app declares
Stay up after you close it; you control the window
limits.differs: Android 12 added auto-enter and seamless resize. iPhone has had it since iOS 14.

story.what_it_is: Keeps a video playing in a small window while you use other apps.

marketing.name: Picture in picture
marketing.pitch: Developer guide: let users keep watching a video in a small floating window as they use other apps.

marketing.name: Picture in Picture
marketing.pitch: Developer guide: let video keep playing in a floating window so people can use other apps at the same time.

story.for_you: You start a video call or movie, go to another app, and a small window keeps playing in the corner. You can drag it, resize it or close it. It feels like real multitasking.
story.for_makers: Keeps people watching or on a call while they multitask, which raises time spent and fewer drop offs. Makers must turn it on, and on Android you can turn it off per app.

use_cases.example: You watch a show and answer a text, and the show keeps playing in a corner.
A video call shrinks to a corner window so you can open a notes app and keep talking.
Navigation shrinks to a small window so you can check a message and still see turns.
A sports app keeps a live game in a corner while you check scores.
A cloud gaming or streaming app keeps your friend's stream in a small window while you play.
A lecture video stays in view while you take notes in another app.
Ad makers note that PiP can pause or hide ads, so some services limit it to paid plans.

risks: Hidden window may keep camera on
story.android_note: Turn on per app, and users can disable it for any app in Settings.
story.ios_note: Supported for video through AVKit, and for video calls on newer systems.
